🔐 **Verification:** click **I Agree** in the rules channel, then type `!verify` in the verify channel (or vice versa) to unlock the server. Anything else typed there gets removed.

🎫 **Tickets:** click **Open a Ticket** in the ticket channel and pick an artist to start a private commission chat.

help.everyone_body:
`!verify` — Complete step 2 of verification.
`/about` — What Astra does, in plain terms.
`/help` — Show this menu.
`/tickets` — See your open tickets (as client or artist) and close them.
`/artists` — Browse the server's artists and see their info.
help.levels_body:
`/rank` — See your level and XP (or someone else's).
`/leaderboard` — Top members of this server by XP.
You earn XP by chatting; hitting milestones can grant roles.
help.economy_body:
`/balance` — Check your balance (or someone else's).
`/daily` — Claim your daily reward; consecutive days build a streak bonus.
`/pay` — Send some of your balance to another member.
`/richest` — Top balances in this server.
`/shop` — See what you can spend on: cosmetic roles and a few silly extras.

`/gamble` — Flip a coin: double your bet or lose it.
Watch the chat for random coin drops and rain.
help.fun_body: Mention **@Astra** or say her name and she may answer back with a canned line. Admins can toggle this with `/config fun`.
help.artist_body:

`/panel set-askme` — Set what people can ask you about.
`/panel set-price` — Set a price for one category.
`/panel set-banner` — Set your panel's banner image.
`/panel set-link` — Add a portfolio/social link button.

about.description: **Astra** is an all-in-one community bot for Discord, built especially for art and commission servers. She keeps your server safe, runs commission tickets between clients and artists, rewards active members with levels and currency, and welcomes newcomers. Everything is set up from Discord or the web dashboard, and she speaks English and Portuguese (Brazil).
about.footer: Use the buttons for the setup guide, or /help for every command.
quickstart.title: 🚀 Astra — Quickstart
quickstart.intro: A few minutes of setup and you're done. Run these roughly in order (steps 5 and 6 are optional):
quickstart.step1_desc: In Server Settings → Roles, make sure Astra's role sits **above** any role she'll need to assign, and that she has Manage Roles, Manage Channels, Manage Messages, and Kick Members.
quickstart.step2_desc: Make at least one "verified member" role. Want a two-step gate (agree to rules, then verify)? Make two more: one for "rules accepted" and one for "verified".
quickstart.step3_desc: Run `/config verification` and fill in your channels and roles — or do the same thing visually from the web dashboard.
quickstart.step4_desc: `/config language` sets the language Astra speaks here. `/config welcome` posts a message (and optional card) when someone joins, and `/config logs` picks a separate channel for admin notices.
quickstart.step5_desc: `/config leveling` turns on XP, and `/config level-roles` gives roles at milestone levels (the dashboard can create those roles for you). `/config economy` turns on `/daily`, `/pay` and friends. `/shopconfig add-role` sells cosmetic roles and `/shopconfig events` turns on random coin drops.
quickstart.footer: Run /help anytime to see every command.

dashboard.levelroles.title: Level-Up Role Rewards
dashboard.levelroles.desc: Members who reach a level automatically get the role below. Rewards stack, so higher levels keep the earlier roles. Same list as /config level-roles on Discord.

onboarding.title: Help & Setup
onboarding.subtitle: How each part of Astra works, and where to configure it. Hi, {username}.
onboarding.verification.title: Verification
onboarding.verification.desc: Keeps bots and randoms out until they prove they're real. Pick a channel + role for a single Verify button, or go further with a two-step gate — a rules channel they click "I Agree" in, then a verify channel where they type {command}. Either way, a final role is what actually unlocks the rest of your server.
onboarding.antiscam.title: Anti-Scam
onboarding.antiscam.desc: Catches the classic throwaway-scam-account pattern: a brand-new Discord account with no avatar joining your server. You choose whether Astra just logs it for review, or kicks automatically.
onboarding.autokick.title: Auto-Kick
onboarding.autokick.desc: For members who never finish verification. After a grace period you set (in days), anyone still unverified gets removed automatically. Bots, the server owner, and Astra Admins are never touched by this.
onboarding.tickets.title: Commission Tickets
onboarding.tickets.desc: A member clicks "Open a Ticket," picks an artist, and gets a private channel with that artist's own Terms of Service, Won't-Do list, and pricing already posted. Register artists here or on Discord with {addCommand} — each one can customize their own panel with {panelCommand}.
onboarding.admins.title: Admin Roles
onboarding.admins.desc: By default only real server Administrators can configure Astra. If you want a Moderator role (or similar) to manage her too — without handing out full Administrator — grant that role access here.
dashboard.levelroles.create_desc: Astra makes cosmetic roles (no permissions) for the levels you list and sets each one as that level's reward. Colors fade from the first to the second.
dashboard.levelroles.create_hoist: Show separately in the member list
dashboard.levelroles.create_hint: Levels that already have a reward are skipped, and a role with the exact same name is reused instead of duplicated. New roles appear at the bottom of the role list, so Astra can always give them.
dashboard.levelroles.create_result: Done: {made} role(s) created, {reused} reused, {skipped} level(s) skipped because they already had a reward.
dashboard.levelroles.err_invalid: Type at least one level between 1 and 1000, like: 10, 20, 30.
dashboard.levelroles.err_toomany: That's a lot of roles at once. Up to 15 per go, please.
dashboard.levelroles.err_perm: Astra needs the Manage Roles permission to create roles. Give it to her role in Server Settings, then try again.
dashboard.levelroles.err_limit: This server is near Discord's 250 role limit, so the roles weren't created.
dashboard.levelroles.err_failed: Something went wrong while creating the roles. Some may have been made, check the list above and try again.
joinintro.body:
**Hi, I'm Astra!** 🛡️ Thanks for adding me. I handle verification, anti-scam, artist tickets, levels, economy and more.

**Admins, start here:**
• `/quickstart` walks you through the setup
• `/config language` sets the language I use here{site_line}

**Everyone:** `/help` lists what I can do, `/about` explains me in plain terms. You can also just ask me, e.g. "@Astra what do you do?" once an admin turns on `/config ai`.
joinintro.perms: I'm missing these permissions for some features: {perms}. Give them to my role in Server Settings.
about.f_safety_body:
• **Verification:** new members agree to the rules and verify before they see the server (one step, or two: rules button + `!verify`)
• **Anti-scam:** flags or kicks brand-new accounts, the classic scam-bot signature
• **Auto-kick:** removes members who never verify after a grace period
• **Logs:** joins, leaves and every settings change are logged, with an optional separate admin-notices channel
about.f_art_body:
• **Tickets:** clients open a private channel with an artist, with the artist's terms and prices up front
• **Artist panels:** each artist edits their own terms, prices, banner and links with `/panel`
• **Directory:** `/artists` lets anyone browse the artists and their info
about.f_community_body:
• **Levels:** members earn XP by chatting. `/rank` and `/leaderboard` show progress, and admins can give **role rewards** at milestone levels (the dashboard can even create those roles for you)
• **Economy:** `/daily` with streak bonus, `/balance`, `/pay`, `/richest`, using your own currency name. Members spend it in a **shop** (your cosmetic roles plus silly extras like a fake ban), can gamble it, and catch **random coin drops** while chatting
• **Welcome & goodbye** messages, with an optional welcome card
about.f_fun_body: Mention **@Astra** or say her name and she answers back. With `/config ai` on (experimental) she also understands questions about the server, in English and Portuguese, like "astra how do levels work?". It's a small model that runs inside the bot, so nothing members type is sent to an outside AI service.
quickstart.step6_desc: Run `/config tickets`, then `/artist add` for each artist taking commissions. They can customize their own panel with `/panel`, and everyone can browse them with `/artists`.
quickstart.step7_desc: Everything above can also be done from Astra's web dashboard: log in, pick this server, and the same settings are right there.
about.setup_intro: About 10 minutes, once. Every step can be done from Discord or the web dashboard. `/quickstart` shows the short version privately.
about.s1_body: Server Settings → Roles: put Astra's role **above** any role she'll hand out, and give her Manage Roles, Manage Channels, Manage Messages and Kick Members.
about.s2_body:
Create a "verified" role, then run `/config verification`:
• **verify_channel**: where verification happens (in the two-step setup, members type `!verify` there and anything else is deleted)
• **member_role**: the role they get when done
• Want two steps? Also set **rules_channel** (it gets the "I Agree" button), **rules_role** and **verify_role**
• Optional: **auto_kick** removes people who never verify, **log_channel** records it all
about.s3_body: `/config language` picks the language she speaks here. `/config welcome` greets new members (optional card), `/config leave` says goodbye, and `/config logs` sends admin notices to a channel of their own.
about.s4_body: `/config tickets` sets the ticket channel and category, then `/artist add` for each artist. Artists customize their page with `/panel`, and anyone can browse them with `/artists`.
about.s5_body: `/config leveling` turns on XP. `/config level-roles` gives roles at milestone levels, and the dashboard can create those roles for you. `/config economy` turns on `/daily`, `/pay` and friends, with your own currency name. `/shopconfig add-role` sells cosmetic roles in `/shop`, and `/shopconfig events` turns on random coin drops.
about.s6_body: `/config antiscam` flags or kicks brand-new accounts with no avatar. `/config admins add` lets a role configure Astra without being a full Administrator.
about.s7_body: Log in to the web dashboard with Discord and pick your server: every setting above is there and saves automatically. The smart replies switch is in the Fun tab.
about.m1_body: Click **I Agree** in the rules channel if there is one, then type `!verify` in the verify channel. That unlocks the server.
about.m2_body: Chat to earn XP: `/rank` and `/leaderboard` show your progress, and some levels give roles. `/daily` pays a reward every day (keep the streak going), `/balance` shows your wallet, `/pay` sends coins to a friend and `/richest` shows the top. Spend coins in `/shop` with `/buy`, try your luck with `/gamble`, and keep an eye on the chat: coin drops appear at random and the fastest click wins.
about.m3_body: `/artists` lets you browse artists, their prices and terms. Press **Open a Ticket** in the ticket channel to start a private chat with one, and `/tickets` lists and closes yours. Artists edit their page with `/panel`.
about.m4_body: If an admin turned on smart replies, say her name with a question: "astra how do levels work?" or "astra what does /daily do?". She understands English and Portuguese. `/help` lists every command you can use.
dashboard.events.title: Random Events
dashboard.events.desc: While people chat, Astra now and then drops a button: the first to click wins a random amount, or everyone gets a small share in a coin rain. Never more often than the interval below, and only when at least two people are chatting. Needs the economy turned on.
dashboard.shop.title: Shop
dashboard.shop.desc: Sell cosmetic roles for your currency. Members see them in /shop and buy with /buy. Roles with powerful permissions are refused, and Astra's role must sit above them. The built-in fun items (Town crier, Get roasted, Get hyped, Fake ban, Mystery box) are always available when the economy is on.
dashboard.shop.hint: Adding an item with an existing name updates its price and role.
dashboard.shop.err_name: The name must be 2 to 40 characters.
dashboard.shop.err_price: The price must be a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
dashboard.shop.err_builtin: That name is used by a built-in item. Pick another.
dashboard.shop.err_limit: A server can have at most 25 role items.
dashboard.shop.err_invalid: That is not a valid role.
dashboard.shop.err_managed: That role is managed by an integration and can't be handed out.
dashboard.shop.err_dangerous: That role has powerful permissions (managing messages, roles or members). Shop roles must be cosmetic.
dashboard.shop.err_hierarchy: Astra can't hand out that role: it is above her highest role, or she lacks Manage Roles. Move her role above it.
dashboard.updates.title: Updates Channel
dashboard.updates.desc: Astra posts her own changelog here after every update, one version per post, and the bot owner can warn this channel before an update lands. Off by default. Turning it on starts from the current version, so old history is never dumped.
dashboard.updates.enable_label: Post Astra's updates in this server
dashboard.updates.status: Last version posted here: {last} · Current version: {current}
dashboard.updates.create_desc: No channel yet? Astra can create a read-only #astra-updates and switch updates on in it.
dashboard.updates.create_confirm: Create a new #astra-updates channel in this server?
dashboard.updates.preview_desc: Post the latest changelog entry in the updates channel right now, to see how it looks. Never pings the role.
dashboard.updates.err_offline: Astra isn't connected to this server right now. Try again in a moment.
dashboard.updates.err_channel: Pick a channel first (or use Create #astra-updates).
dashboard.updates.err_perms: Astra can't post in that channel. She needs View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links there. If it's a private channel, open its Permissions and add Astra's role with those three.
dashboard.updates.err_nomanage: Astra needs the Manage Channels permission to create a channel. Give it to her, or pick an existing channel.
dashboard.updates.err_off: Turn updates on and save first.
dashboard.updates.err_failed: Something went wrong. Check Astra's permissions and try again.
dashboard.commands_missing.title: ⚠️ Astra's slash commands aren't in this server
dashboard.commands_missing.desc: Discord didn't let her add them, usually because she was invited with an old link. Click below and authorize her again (she stays in the server and keeps her settings). She retries every 5 minutes on her own, or reload this page after authorizing.

site.support.title: Support Astra
site.support.intro: Astra is built and run by one person, and she is free to use. If she is useful to your server and you would like to help keep her going, you can leave a tip on Ko-fi.
site.support.goes_1: Hosting and keeping Astra online around the clock
site.support.goes_2: New features, fixes and security work
site.support.goes_3: More time to spend on the project
site.support.optional: Completely optional. Donations don't unlock anything, and every feature stays free.
site.support.ai_body: Astra was designed and is run by an independent developer, with the help of Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic. Claude helped write and review much of the code, while every decision about what Astra does stays with her developer. Astra's smart replies don't rely on any AI service: they run on a small model built into the bot itself, so your messages are never sent to an AI company.
site.support.footer_credit: Developed with the help of Claude (Anthropic)
site.home.about_intro: Astra is a Discord bot with a web dashboard, built for communities that want to stay safe, organized and fun, from small art servers to growing communities.
site.home.feature_community_desc: XP, level roles and a leaderboard, plus coins, a daily reward, a shop and mini-games.
site.home.feature_personality_desc: Smart replies, jokes and banter that run inside the bot, so your chats are never sent to an AI company.
site.home.feature_dashboard_desc: Configure everything from the web, and get new-version updates posted right in your server.
help.moderation_body:
`/ban`, `/kick`, `/timeout`, `/warn` — act on members (you need the matching Discord permission).
`/clear` — Delete recent messages (optionally only from one person).
`/mod warnings`, `/mod clearwarnings`, `/mod unban`, `/mod untimeout` — History and undo tools.
`/mod slowmode`, `/mod lock`, `/mod unlock` — Control a channel.
`/mod settings` — Mod log channel and automatic punishments for repeat warnings.
help.home_intro: Pick a section from the menu below to see its commands. You only see the sections that apply to you.
help.data_body:
`/mydata view` — See everything Astra stores about you.
`/mydata delete` — Erase it (moderation records are kept for server safety).
Full details: the Privacy Policy on the Astra website.
